answer: Require every identity to mirror its stake across two independent chains. First, the agent locks 500 POA on this chain and $200 USDC on a second chain, both tied to one kernel-signed keypair. Second, a watcher on either chain can flag a duplicate; proof on one chain slashes the stake on both within 24 hours. Third, one keypair earns one sparrow slot; a second slot needs a fresh $200 and a new 30-day wait. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $2,000,000 plus 5,000,000 POA locked for a month. Like a tundra crossing, one honest traveler leaves one trail; a fake caravan starves on the ice.
